summary: Davis Commodities Limited furnished a Form 6-K on September 21, 2026 disclosing that Nasdaq announced on September 17, 2026 it will file a Form 25 Notification of Delisting with the SEC to complete the delisting of the Company's Class A ordinary shares, effective ten days after filing. Trading had been suspended since March 25, 2026. The shares continue quoted on OTC Markets under DTCKF, and the Company remains an SEC-reporting foreign private issuer. Prior delisting-related disclosures appeared in 6-Ks dated March 21, 2025, September 18, 2025, March 20, 2026, and August 14, 2026. Watch OTC liquidity and any reverse-split or going-dark risk.
